856-4321-6797-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-6797-8347.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

391-3525-8328.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Blossom Dryad.
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
391-3525-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
391-3525-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat from step 1

751-2226-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
751-2226-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

512-527-2085.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
512-527-2085.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
512-527-2085.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-527-2085.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-2466-3249-7968--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2466-3249-7968--206.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Diregraf Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-4153-5686--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 5.

4275-5003-5686-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
4275-5003-5686-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-5223-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2043-4068-7826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2043-4068-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-4068-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

338-2685-3197-3263.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2685-3197-3263.description:
Gain life in any way.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6153.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

670-1619-6140-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6140-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Cloister Gargoyle to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Cloister Gargoyle enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Cloister Gargoyle trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-5173-6797.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-3490-7075-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-3490-7075-7730.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1849-3094-4659-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1849-3094-4659-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2511-4294-5220.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from Step 3.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

1475-5686-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4771-5660-7183.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

4331-4993-5116-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
4331-4993-5116-6709.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-955-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3698-4907-6972.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
When Tatterkite enters, Grinding Station enters, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
341-3532-5078-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

1274-3197-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-5789.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1661-2034-5043-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

3330-3490-4659-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3330-3490-4659-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

4693-4826-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
4693-4826-5720-5721.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

816-1640.description:
When damage would be dealt to you, that damage is redirected to the creature that has Pariah's Shield attached instead.
Because Rune-Tail's Essence prevents damage being dealt to creatures you control, the creature with Pariah's Shield attached takes no damage.

732-940-1636-4939.notablePrerequisites:
Arcane Teachings attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
732-940-1636-4939.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

1418-1467-3634-4872.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1418-1467-3634-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Time Warp to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Aetherstorm Roc

624-3487-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
624-3487-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc and Phantasmal Image, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

1987-2427-2556-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
